(taken from the author's site) In my opinion Calibre is a marvelous tool but is too big and has too much dependencies to be used for its content server. That's the main reason why I coded this OPDS server. I needed a simple tool to be installed on a small server (Seagate Dockstar in my case). So COPS's main advantages are : No need for many dependencies. No need for a lot of CPU or RAM. Not much code. Search is available.
